newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Sth Korea's Kookmin Bank registered in New Zealand.
newsitem.headline: Sth Korea's Kookmin Bank registered in New Zealand.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Monday Kookmin Bank had been registered as a bank in New Zealand and would operate as a branch.
"It is the first South Korean bank to be registered in New Zealand," the RBNZ said.
The move brings the number of registered banks to 19.
Formerly known as the Citizen's National Bank, Kookmin is one of the largest banks in Korea annd is the pre-eminent bank in Korea's retail maket.

Kookmin used to be government owned but has been privatised in recent years, and the government's stake has dropped to 17 percent. At end-1996, Kookmin's unrealised (and unreserved) losses on securities were 12 percent of the bank's equity.
